name: VECTOR_POINT_OF_CONSUMPTION_PROOF_V1
principle: Proof ends where the intended customer or downstream system successfully consumes the outcome, not where the upstream component reports success.

examples.deployment: build -> start -> health -> public route -> app identity -> user action
examples.integration: connect -> send -> provider accepts -> destination reflects -> reconciliation agrees
examples.payroll: calculate -> export -> payroll ingests -> employee result reconciles
examples.training: author -> publish -> learner opens -> completes -> mastery evidence persists
examples.autopilot: recommend -> simulate -> authorise -> act -> independent readback -> business outcome
